description: Adopts the shared Kataglyphis Renovate preset. Everything this repo needs is in there, so this file is deliberately one line of policy: the whole point of the preset is that consumers do not each carry their own copy of the rules.

The preset enables Renovate's git-submodules manager. The local driver checks both direct gitlinks against each remote's default branch even when Renovate omits them; `.gitmodules branch =` does not select the local update target.

It also pins third-party GitHub Actions by digest (astral-sh/setup-uv, the one third-party action web.yml calls, is pinned that way with its tag as a comment) while explicitly NOT proposing pins for Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure composite actions, which are resolved at @develop on purpose for the upstream-first change flow.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure` from ANTfrastructure's DEFAULT BRANCH, so a preset change only reaches this repo once it is merged there - not from the pin in third_party/ANTfrastructure.
